orrery.server.path.markdownDescription: The orrery CLI to run as the language server: a `.mjs` or `.js` file run with `node` (such as `skills/orrery/scripts/orrery.mjs` in a checkout, relative to the first workspace folder) or an `orrery` executable. Empty runs `npx -y @sagargupta1610/orrery lsp`. Reload the window after changing it.

orrery.trace.server.description: Log the messages between VS Code and orrery lsp in the orrery output channel.
